//: vlmkit visual + a11y gate for the orders console. Run with `pnpm vrt` (see package.json). Findings triage and rationale: vrt/README.md

defaults.//gates: Every gate is pinned to vrt/orders.har, so CI needs NO dev server and NO port: the HAR replays index.html, app.css and /api/orders exactly as recorded, which also freezes /api/orders' moving order ids and totals. Re-record with `pnpm vrt:record` when the page starts calling a new endpoint. `--wait-until load --timeout 15000` is required because networkidle never fires on this app (serve.mjs holds /api/stream open); `vlmkit gates init` added those two flags itself and said why.
defaults.//rules: ONE deliberate re-tuning; every other rule keeps the gate's own default severity so the triage list stays the tool's opinion, not ours. check.design/component-drift: demoted warn -> info. The console has exactly 3 buttons and one is the primary action, so the 'button' role can never reach the 3x-reuse floor the rule needs; `--min-reuse 2` does not silence it either (measured average reuse is 1.5). Kept at info rather than off so the measurement reappears if the footer grows and genuinely fragments. NOTE: unlike `suppressions`, a `rules` entry has no reason/owner/expires field, so this paragraph is the only place the decision can be recorded and nothing will ever force it to be revisited.

pages.//source: The URL is the HAR's lookup key, not a live host — nothing has to be listening on 4321 for this to run. If the port inside vrt/orders.har changes, this string must change with it.
